# Paulo Vieira Silva

> DevOps & Platform Engineer | IT Operations. Paulo Vieira Silva is a DevOps & Platform Engineer running Google Cloud, the data platform and internal products at Smarter Sorting, and IT for Pareto AI on a consulting contract. $600k/year in cloud savings delivered; 1.4 TB migrated with zero downtime. Based in Vila Velha, Brazil; remote on US hours. Portuguese and English.

This site is Paulo Vieira Silva's CV. Prefer the Markdown or JSON files below over scraping the HTML.

Current roles: DevOps Engineer at Smarter Sorting (since Jul 2025) · IT Consultant at Pareto AI (since Apr 2026).
